prompt:
Task / size class:
BWJ-2 corrective / Loop 105 — MEDIUM, clean-base prepare-only Blue Cloud Work wake builder.

Implement BWJ-2 from the current clean target snapshot. A previous BWJ-2 Jules session failed before publishing any durable code because an expires_at=None negative case incorrectly returned PREPARED. Do not depend on inaccessible prior workspace state. Implement the bounded prepare-only adapter cleanly from the current repository and make expiry validation fail closed.

Read first:
- docs/BLUE_WORK_JULES_WEBHOOK_LOOP_ROADMAP.md (BWJ-2 only)
- docs/CLOUD_WORK_LANES_INDEX.md
- automation/command_bus/blue_jules_result_event.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_jules_result_event.py
- automation/command_bus/reviewer_wake_backend.py

  automation/cloud_work_lanes/carriers/blue_v1.md
- current Blue worker state on cloud-work/carrier-blue-v1:
  automation/cloud_work_lanes/carriers/blue_worker_state_v1.json

Allowed changed paths only:
- automation/command_bus/blue_work_wake_prepare.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_work_wake_prepare.py

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- only the two allowed files
- no workflow/schema/docs/dependency/config/lockfile changes
- no GitHub API/client/network/filesystem I/O or writes
- no PR review/comment submission
- no real Cloud Work wake or worker-generation mutation
- no Jules claim/command/session creation
- no provider/model execution
- no webhook server/listener/poller/queue/database/scheduler/framework
- no BWJ-3+
- no merge/rebase/force push/branch delete/default-branch write
- retry=0; fallback=disabled

Reuse-first:
- Import and reuse EventDecision / EventClassificationResult from blue_jules_result_event.py.
- Reuse repository fail-closed validation style.
- Reuse the exact current Blue Cloud Work command fields and prefix; do not invent a second command schema.
- Keep carrier generation and related identity as explicit fresh inputs. Do not hardcode generation=1.

Required semantics:
1. Provide one importable pure prepare function.
2. Inputs include:
   - BWJ-1 EventClassificationResult
   - Blue carrier snapshot with protocol_version, lane, command_prefix, worker_generation
   - result target snapshot with target_repository, target_pr, target_branch, expected_target_head, current_target_head
   - explicit existing Blue logical command IDs
   - expires_at
   - explicit timezone-aware now
3. Prepare state vocabulary exactly PREPARED, NO_OP, STALE, UNKNOWN.
4. BWJ-1 IGNORE -> NO_OP/no review body.
5. BWJ-1 UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN/no review body.
6. Only WAKE may reach PREPARED.
7. Carrier validation:
   protocol_version == 1;
   lane == "blue";
   command_prefix == "[CW_BLUE_V1]";
   worker_generation positive int and bool invalid.
8. Result validation:
   target_repository exactly "kamiyusense/multi-ai-council-phase0";
   target_pr positive int and bool invalid;
   target_branch nonempty and not main/master;
   expected_target_head/current_target_head exact lowercase 40-hex.
9. Cross-bind classification.command_id exactly to:
   blue-jules-result-pr<target_pr>-<expected_target_head>.
   Missing/malformed/mismatch -> UNKNOWN.
10. current_target_head != expected_target_head -> STALE/no review body.
11. Duplicate exact command_id in existing IDs -> NO_OP, preserve command_id, no body.
12. Malformed existing-ID collection -> UNKNOWN.
13. Expiry validation is strict and fail-closed:
   - expires_at must be a nonempty string
   - parse as ISO-8601
   - must include timezone offset
   - now must be timezone-aware datetime
   - expires_at > now strictly
   - expires_at=None, "", malformed, naive timestamp, equal-now, or expired => UNKNOWN
   - never substitute a default expiry; never derive/read wall clock internally
14. PREPARED body is exactly:
   first line [CW_BLUE_V1]
   then one deterministic valid JSON object with exactly these keys:
   protocol_version
   command_id
   worker_generation
   target_repository
   target_pr
   target_branch
   expected_target_head
   expires_at
   task
   allowed_paths
   verification
   live_provider_or_model_allowed
   retry
   fallback
15. Fixed values:
   allowed_paths=[]
   live_provider_or_model_allowed=false
   retry=0
   fallback="disabled"
16. task is a bounded read-only controller instruction: fresh-read GitHub; verify exact J-BLUE claim/command/session/result lineage and current result head; independently inspect paths/semantics/negative tests/test evidence; return PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN plus one bounded next-task proposal; perform no target write and do not dispatch Jules.
17. verification explicitly requires:
   - fresh result PR/branch/head readback
   - durable J-BLUE lineage verification
   - independent diff/test evidence inspection
   - confirmation no target write/Jules dispatch/live provider execution occurred
18. Identical inputs -> byte-identical body.
19. No I/O or mutation.

Negative/tamper cases:
- valid WAKE + valid fresh inputs -> PREPARED and parseable body
- exact key set and fixed values asserted
- deterministic body asserted
- IGNORE -> NO_OP
- UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN
- duplicate -> NO_OP/same command_id
- mismatched deterministic identity -> UNKNOWN
- current head moved -> STALE
- malformed heads -> UNKNOWN
- wrong repo/default branch/malformed PR -> UNKNOWN
- wrong prefix/lane/protocol -> UNKNOWN
- generation zero/negative/bool/non-int -> UNKNOWN
- expires_at=None -> UNKNOWN (this is the previously missed case)
- expires_at="" -> UNKNOWN
- malformed/naive/equal-now/expired expiry -> UNKNOWN
- naive now -> UNKNOWN
- malformed existing command IDs -> UNKNOWN
- no vacuous/name-only tests

Acceptance criteria:
- exact two-file path fence
- reuses BWJ-1 types
- all negative cases above direct-tested
- deterministic exact [CW_BLUE_V1] review body
- no side effects/live execution/BWJ-3+
- focused tests pass
- full command-bus suite passes
- compileall passes
- git diff --check passes

Exact validation commands:
python -m unittest automation.command_bus.tests.test_blue_work_wake_prepare -v
python -m unittest discover -s automation/command_bus/tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q automation/command_bus
git diff --check

Publication condition:
Only after exact allowed-path fence and all validations are green, create the normal Jules result PR from the isolated work branch descendant. Do not Merge. Do not post [CW_BLUE_V1].

Explicit stop conditions:
- any required path outside the two allowed files
- any GitHub/network/live Work/Jules/provider execution required
- current Blue protocol would require schema change
- BWJ-3+ required
- safety/fail-closed semantics would need weakening
